additional_context: FHIR-16337 and FHIR-16490 removed ExpansionProfile for R4 and replaced its expansion-control role with explicit $expand parameters. FHIR-17558 removed stale ValueSet ExpansionProfile references and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-41589 later refined the current expansion.parameter guidance to SHOULD record client-used input parameters, server-defaulted values, and terminology artifacts used, and Confluence minutes confirm the work group intentionally did not make this a blanket SHALL. The parameterSource extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than active core source.
